forum.title: STTH10002's Humidity working range
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @Ludovic\_Douillard, to the community!

There is no maximum specified RH as an ambient condition during use, but you should avoid condensation.

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
Hello to all,

I am looking for the min-max humidity working ranges of the STTH10002TV1 diode (in %) as I can't find it in the product specification.

Is there a general value for all the ST's diodes? If so, where can I find it ?

Thank you for your time,

Best regards,
forum.author: Ludovic_Douillard

scraped_replies.html:
Welcome @Ludovic_Douillard, to the community!

There is no maximum specified RH as an ambient condition during use, but you should avoid condensation.

Hope that helps?

Regards
/Peter
